explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 217 days before the posting

sentences.text: Propofol is on FDA's shortage list, first posted 2020-04-10, and has been listed for 78 months as of 2026-10-21.
FDA inspection 1106244 at Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-05-25, 217 days before the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2020-03-25, 16 days before the posting.
Corvale General holds 343 vials of the 20 mL presentation at 15.8 vials per day, providing 21.7 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 10 vials of the 20 mL presentation at 2 vials per day, providing 5 days on hand.
The top-ranked option is to transfer 18 vials of 10 mg/mL, 20 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside, which would give Corvale General two weeks of supply and bring Corvale Lakeside to 14 days.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
